žabilan: žabilan — cross-legged (adverb or converb; stem uncertain) [盤脚]
saγ̇užu: saγ̇u- — to sit; converb -žu, 'sitting' (verb, converb) [坐着]

qačiγ̇un: Qačiγ̇un — Qachi'un, a son's name (personal name) [(兒)名]

čeġeži: čeġeži — breast, bosom (noun; Ming 胷懷) [胷懷]

barγužin: Barγužin — Barqujin, a place name (Ming 地名) (place name) [地名]
